blind.description: A thick, ornate fantasy book / tome lying flat on the ground. It features a red/maroon leather cover with gold metal corner reinforcements, clasps, and a central embossed gold sun/burst emblem with a domed central stud. The pages are cream/parchment colored, bound tightly with gold ribbing along the spine. The mesh is clean, solid, and continuous with no hovering elements, fused blobs, or broken geometry. The underside sits flat on the floor.
blind.from_above: A square-ish red rectangle with ornate gold corner caps, gold edge clasps, and a bright golden radiant sun emblem with a domed center directly in the middle of the front cover.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 4 to 5 inches thick (lying flat) and roughly 1.2 to 1.5 feet long and wide, around one-fifteenth the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure.
